VI.description: The RemoteVI server: ONE While Loop\2C no event structure (docs\5Carchitecture.md\2C tools\5Cmock-server\5Cserver.mjs). Before the loop it creates a TCP listener on port (all interfaces) and sends its error cluster on the notifier <stop notifier name>\3Astarted (RemoteVI Start.vi waits for it\2C so a port in use is reported to the caller)\2C obtains the notifier named stop notifier name and builds the greeting from the name of VI (RemoteVI Greeting.vi). Each iteration\3A ACCEPT - waits at most 5 ms for a connection and hands it to RemoteVI Accept Clients.vi\2C which keeps accepted connections PENDING and reads their request heads with zero-timeout reads\2C serves a complete head (RemoteVI Handle Connection.vi\2C at most 8 WebSocket clients)\2C greets and adds an upgraded connection as a client\2C and drops one that has sent no complete head within 5 s - so an idle connection (a browser's speculative preconnect) never stalls the loop. POPUPS (docs\5Carchitecture.md\2C section Popups) - RemoteVI Track Popups.vi lists the LabVIEW popups (Win32 only - while a popup is open LabVIEW's UI thread is in a modal loop and every VI Server UI call blocks) whenever a client is connected\2C a popup was open last time or the geometry is due\2C hides on the host the popups a remote click opened (within 1 s) and tip strips that can only stem from the remote pointer\2C and gives the modal popups at their LOGICAL positions (real - d). WINDOWS (docs\5Cprotocol.md section 7) - RemoteVI Track Windows.vi lists the application's other windows (dialogs\2C native file dialogs\2C subVI panels\3B Win32 only)\3B while one of them is modal LabVIEW's UI thread runs the dialog's modal loop and the loop makes no VI Server call\2C exactly as while a popup is open. GEOMETRY - the panel geometry and window handle are cached (RemoteVI Get Panel Geometry.vi before the loop\2C then every 500 ms and right after a popup closes - RemoteVI Refresh Geometry.vi - but only while NO popup is open and not within 300 ms of a click). SERVICE - every client is serviced (RemoteVI Service Clients.vi) with the cached geometry\2C handle and popups\3B the displacement d it returns is kept for the next iteration (reset when the last popup closes). HOVER - RemoteVI Menu Hover.vi applies the remote pointer a client moved over an open LabVIEW menu with keys (the highlight follows it with VK_DOWN / VK_UP\2C VK_RIGHT after 400 ms on an item opens its submenu\2C VK_LEFT closes submenus when the pointer rests on a parent) - no cursor and no menu is moved. ORIGIN - where the panel starts inside the frame (below the menu bar and toolbar) is cached with the geometry\3B a new client gets it with its greeting (RemoteVI Origin Message.vi)\2C and RemoteVI Send Origin.vi tells all clients when it changed. FRAMES - RemoteVI Capture And Send.vi makes a frame at most every 1000/fps ms while a client is connected - every 16 ms while a client posted a click or a key in this iteration or within the last 300 ms (recent click?)\2C so the change it causes reaches the browser at once instead of up to one frame period later - and sends it to each client\3B a frame is the whole window below its title bar (menu bar\2C toolbar\2C panel\2C scrollbars)\2C copied from the window's composited surface (RemoteVI Capture Frame.vi) - no VI Server call\2C so frames keep coming while a popup is open. OTHER WINDOWS - RemoteVI Send Windows.vi sends each client the list (windows [...]) when it changed and\2C in an iteration that made a frame\2C each window's changes as a WINDOW FRAME (seq and flow control shared with FRAME)\3B input goes to the window RemoteVI Route Input.vi picks. OVERLAY - RemoteVI Send Overlay.vi sends the popups as an OVERLAY message when it changed (docs\5Cprotocol.md section 3.2)\3B not in an iteration that made a frame (its period is then 1e9 ms) but in the next one\2C 1 ms later - capturing and PNG-encoding the popups right after the frame made the iteration\2C and with it the frame gap\2C longer (measured). Closed clients are dropped and their connections closed (RemoteVI Drop Closed Clients.vi). The loop stops when the notifier delivers anything\2C when VI is no longer running (RemoteVI VI Stopped.vi\2C once a second while VI Server may be called - so the server ends with your application)\2C or on a listener error other than a timeout. Then every client gets close 1001\2C every connection and the listener are closed and the notifier released. Launched asynchronously by RemoteVI Start.vi.
